verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird runs a public TwoVenture hub that offers guidance to start-ups and their investors across the venture capital life cycle (Start & Seed, Scale & Growth, Exit & Beyond). On equity, its public pages carry downloadable factsheets on EMI, growth shares, CSOP and SIP. On financing, it offers a free Term Sheet Generator for early-stage German rounds. Missing for 10: evidence of the actual guide or FAQ content inside TwoVenture, any explicit formation or incorporation explainers, confirmation that the material is plain-language and openly accessible, and independent corroboration.
